thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: elevated 504/timeouts observed in eu-west-1 ingress gateway. Error rate ~4.8% over last 6m, spike started ~2078509800. Paging oncall -> Elaine (oncall). Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/ingress/eu-west-1?view=errors (automated)

Elaine (oncall): on it. joining audio. provisioning context: eu-west-1 primary gateway cluster. any recent deploys? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

Ben R: no deploys in the last 30m for gateway. seeing huge TTL backpressure on egress pools -> that looks like connection queuing to downstream services. quick metrics: 504s peaked at 6.1% at 07:12 UTC, p50 latency up from 60ms -> 720ms for proxy handshake.

Alice M: copying in infra. can we short-circuit heavy routes? suggestion: reduce concurrent fanout for model-service-proxy to 50 and enable immediate 429->retry-fallback at edge to drop long waits. will prepare a 1-line hotpatch.

Dave I: applying temporary routing change to mark region eu-west-1 as lower-priority for non-billable traffic. command I ran: ``kubectl -n gateway patch svc gateway-eu-west --patch '{"spec":{"annotations":{"redwood/priority":"low"}}}'``. propagation ~30s.

Elaine (oncall): confirmed change propagated. immediate impact: error rate down to 3.2% after 90s. starting scale-up of ingress (replicas +2) and enabling request-timeout override to 15s (was 60s) to fail fast and reduce queuing. running:
```
kubectl -n gateway scale deploy ingress-eu-west --replicas=8
kubectl -n gateway set env deploy/ingress-eu-west REQUEST_TIMEOUT=15
```

InfraBot: autoscale action triggered by Elaine. New replica count 8 -> 10 in 2m. CPU and net metrics: see https://metrics.redwood.example/ingress/eu-west-1

Carla S: customer-impact check — snapshot from logs: ~2.1k unique requests failed in the 20m window. top affected customers: acme-corp (15% of failed requests), beta-embed (8%), internal-inference-tests (5%). Most failures show upstream handshake timeout 504, some 502 from model-service-proxy.

Elaine (oncall): quick customer assessment: estimated affected user-sessions ~1.8k, proportion of paying customers ~0.9% of active customers in the region. We will send a status update to status.redwood.com and the EU customers mailing list. ETA for containment ~15-25 minutes pending steady decline.

Ben R: propose immediate runbook changes: Add step to reduce REQUEST_TIMEOUT to 15s under high queue-depth, and add a probe to detect when model-service-proxy queue depth > 200 -> trigger early scaling and circuit break to model-service-proxy. New alert suggestion:
- name: ingress_high_queued_requests_eu_west
  expr: sum(gateway_queued_requests{region=\"eu-west-1\"}) > 200
  for: 1m
  severity: page

Alice M: pushed hotfix PR to infra-config to add the circuit-breaker rule and updated gateway timeout defaults. PR: https://git.redwood/infraconfig/pulls/2137. Patch diff (summary):
```
- REQUEST_TIMEOUT=60
+ REQUEST_TIMEOUT=15
+ ENABLE_MODEL_CIRCUIT_BREAKER=true
+ MODEL_CB_QUEUE_THRESHOLD=200
```
Applying as emergency hotpatch with immediate rollout to eu-west-1 only.

Dave I: rolled hotpatch using canary: ``kubectl -n gateway rollout restart deploy/ingress-eu-west-canary`` -> canary healthy after 45s, then rolled to remainder. all pods back to Ready.

Elaine (oncall): monitoring: error rate now 0.8% and sliding p95 latency back to ~120ms. good improvement. marking mitigation phase -> stabilized. Still keeping pager open for handoff notes and follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

Carla S: logging note for postmortem: need correlation between service queue depth and request-timeout defaults. capture sample traces for failed requests (trace ids attached) -> see attached logs on the incident channel thread.

Ben R: action items (short):
- [ ] Alice M: finalize PR and merge emergency flags into mainline
- [ ] Elaine (oncall): draft PM customer update and status page entry (ETA 30m)
- [ ] Dave I: run root-cause probe to see if upstream model-service-proxy had an accept-rate regression between 07:00-07:15
- [ ] Infra team: add alert ingress_high_queued_requests_eu_west and tune for 2m window
- [ ] Carla S: prepare impact spreadsheet for SRE/CS sync

Alice M: merged hotfix to mainline at 2078511100, tagging release 2026.3-hotpatch. adding runbook entry now (section: "regional ingress backpressure -> quick fail/scale play").

Elaine (oncall): scheduling postmortem touchpoint in #incidents-postmortems — proposal: tomorrow 10:00 UTC. Also updating runbook checklist to include: verify model-service-proxy backpressure metrics, adjust REQUEST_TIMEOUT, temporarily deprioritize non-critical traffic.

incident-bot: Incident annotated: severity=page, region=eu-west-1, mitigation=route-prioritization+timeout-reduction+hotpatch-circuit-breaker. Incident created tag: INC-2078509999. Auto-reminder set for postmortem in 24h.

-- 2h later --
Elaine (oncall): follow-up: root-cause probe shows a surge of queued retries from a partner integration that increased connection churn to model-service-proxy. we've asked partner to throttle. final note: hotfix validated, actions created in Terraform and alerts updated. closing pager. :checkered_flag:

Dave I: exported metrics and attached CSV to the postmortem doc: https://docs.redwood.example/incidents/INC-2078509999/postmortem

Carla S: confirmed customer notifications sent, CS has outreach plan for acme-corp. closing thread.
